title: VulnSAGE: Adjudicating SAST Reports by Connecting LLM Reasoning to Program Structure
title_zh: VulnSAGE：通过连接大模型推理与程序结构来裁定SAST报告

paragraphs.en: 总结：VulnSAGE将大模型推理与程序结构相结合，自动判定SAST告警真伪，在多个数据集上显著降低误报并发现多个真实漏洞。 Static Application Security Testing (SAST) reports flag operations whose safety depends on project-specific context, and maintainers must decide which reports describe real defects. Large language models (LLMs) can interpret this context, but adjudicating a report with them requires the decisive code, which often lies far from the reported line, and a decision basis that program analysis can check. We present VulnSAGE, an adjudication system for SAST reports that connects LLM reasoning to program structure in both directions. Its report-centered slicer recovers the dependencies of the reported operation together with the program structure that explains them, such as the caller object on which a helper acts. CLAIM, an intermediate representation for report judgments, records each model interpretation as a semantic fact that cites the program relations it assumes. Program analysis checks these premises, and the verdict follows from the facts whose premises hold. Both mechanisms share a program graph, which lets the model cite the code it reads and lets the checker query those citations. Statically supported true positives then guide proof-of-concept generation and runtime reproduction. Across 187 labeled reports from four corpora covering five vulnerability families, VulnSAGE rejects 89 of 97 false alarms and retains 85 of 90 real defects. Under a common PoC procedure, 25 of its positive verdicts reproduce at runtime, compared with three for the LLM-based adjudicator LLM4SA. Applied to 45,440 alerts raised by five SAST tools on the 200 most-starred C/C++ projects on GitHub, it reproduces 104 defects at runtime. Maintainers have confirmed 24 of the 26 defects they have responded to, including ten previously unknown defects, nine of which are already fixed.
paragraphs.zh: 总结：VulnSAGE将大模型推理与程序结构相结合，自动判定SAST告警真伪，在多个数据集上显著降低误报并发现多个真实漏洞。静态应用安全测试（SAST）的告警所标记的操作，其安全性依赖于项目特定的上下文，维护者必须判断哪些告警描述的是真实缺陷。 大语言模型（LLM）能够解读这种上下文，但用它们来裁定告警既需要决定性的代码——这些代码往往远离被报告的行，也需要一个程序分析可以检验的判定依据。 我们提出VulnSAGE，一个面向SAST告警的裁定系统，它在两个方向上将大模型推理与程序结构连接起来。 其以告警为中心的切片器在恢复被报告操作的依赖关系的同时，还恢复解释这些依赖的程序结构，例如辅助函数所作用的调用者对象。 CLAIM是一种用于告警判定的中间表示，它将模型的每种解读记录为一条语义事实，并引用其假设的程序关系。 程序分析检验这些前提，而判定结论则由前提成立的事实推导得出。 这两种机制共享同一个程序图，这使得模型能够引用它所阅读的代码，也让检验器能够查询这些引用。 有静态支撑的真阳性结果随后可指导概念验证（PoC）生成和运行时复现。 在来自四个语料库、覆盖五类漏洞家族的187条带标签告警上，VulnSAGE拒绝了97个误报中的89个，并保留了90个真实缺陷中的85个。 在一个通用的PoC流程下，其25个阳性判定可在运行时复现，而基于大模型的裁定器LLM4SA仅有3个可复现。 应用于五个SAST工具在GitHub上获星最多的200个C/C++项目上报告的45,440条告警，它在运行时复现了104个缺陷。 在维护者已回应的26个缺陷中，有24个已获确认，其中包括十个此前未知的缺陷，其中九个已被修复。
